Rolling Calendar

The Rolling Calendar is a tentative, working document with items planned for presentation at City Council. The order and date of the agenda items may change as the City Manager directs. This listing may be updated weekly or bi-weekly and is not a guarantee of the items on an upcoming Council agenda. 


Rule of Four: The Rule of Four lists have been consolidated with other Council Directed Work items. Updates are now located the Council Directed Work webpage at LovGov.Org.
